title: Loot Ledger and Treasure Balance
dataSources: Campaign sessions (`campaign:session`), NPC ledger (`npc:ledger`), loot drops (`loot:drop`), XP awards (`xp:award`).
app: Tabletop RPG telemetry — virtual-tabletop session logs (Roll20, Foundry VTT), campaign trackers (World Anvil), and XP / loot / NPC ledgers — streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=loot:drop
| stats sum(gold_value) as loot_value, count as items by character
| eventstats avg(loot_value) as party_avg
| eval imbalance=round(loot_value-party_avg,0)
| sort - imbalance
description: Totals the treasure each character has gained and flags an unfair split before it causes table friction.
value: Loot disputes sour campaigns; a transparent ledger keeps distribution fair and the party happy.
implementation: Ingest loot drops into `index=personal`; total value per character and flag imbalance.
visualization: Bar chart of loot value by character versus party average.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the treasure each character has and flags an unfair split before it causes arguments.
